item.title: Check out the ceilings! Riverfront farm on 25 acres in Virginia. $799,900
item.description: Check out those beautiful hand-painted ceilings! They were done by artist, William Fizzoti, who was born in Rome, Italy. At first blush this price seems a bit steep, but it is on nice acreage on the banks of the Shenandoah River. The house was built in 1865. It is located on 25 acres in Luray, Virginia. item.title: Pretty floors! Almost three acres in New Hampshire. $330,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! There are pretty floors inside! The house was built in 1940. It is located on 276 acres in Acworth, New Hampshire. The house features pretty wood floors, baseboards, built-in bookshelves and pretty door casements. The tractor, generator and piano are staying with the house. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,023 square feet. $330,000 Contact Ashley Bergeron with Bergeron’s Houses to Homes: 603-287-4856 From the Zillow listing: Showings start Tuesday, December 2nd

item.title: Riverfront! Circa 1940 in North Carolina. $249,000
item.description: Pretty river! Pretty area! This riverfront house was built in 1940. It is located on .64 acre in Franklin, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, baseboards and bead board ceilings. Perfect location if you are into kayaking or fishing. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms. $249,000 Contact Daniel O’Connell with eXp Realty From the Zillow listing: Set on 0.64 acres, this riverfront home is high and dry with a large, beautiful, level yard offering rare space

item.title: $65,000! A lot of history with this fixer upper! C. 1857 in Illinois.
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! A lot of history with this house! Originally built for Thomas Marshall, a descendant of U.S. Supreme Court Chief Justice, John Marshall. The house was built in 1857. It is located on .46 acre in Charleston, Illinois. The windows and doors are intact, only boarded up to prohibit entry. item.title: Potential! The Passmore House, C. 1860. Almost four acres in Virginia. $215,900
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! I wish there were more pictures and I wish they showed in the outbuildings! The Passmore House was built in 1860. It is located on 3.9 acres in Keysville, Virginia. The house features a small covered porch, wood floors, wainscoting, exposed beams, picture rails and chair rails. Would love to see inside the other house on the property and there is also a cemetery. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,164 square feet. $215,900 Contact Robert Novak with eXp Realty: 5

item.title: The Williams-Butler Mansion, C. 1895. Three acres in New York. $4,900,000
item.description: The Williams-Butler Mansion is a huge structure with 29,000 square feet of living space along Millionaire’s Row. It was built in 1895.It is located on 3.24 acres in Buffalo, New York. There is a lot of history with this house. It was first built for George L. Williams and his wife Annie. He was a successful banker with Erie County Savings Bank. It was designed by famed architect, Stanford White. It was then sold to Edward H. Butler Jr., publisher of the Buffalo Evening News. item.title: Fun to look through! The De La Pena House, C. 1650 in New Mexico. $9,900,000
item.description: This house and property sure was fun to look through! The De La Pena House is a historic Spanish Pueblo adobe farmhouse with parts dating back to 1650. It was owned by Spanish army officer, Francisco de la Pena in 1845. He and his family lived there for 80 years. In 1925 it was purchased by Frank Applegate, an influential artist, writer and preservationist. item.title: Pretty staircase! Nice yard. Circa 1932 in Ohio. $249,900
item.description: This house has a nice staircase! It could definitely use some carpet removal. The house was built in 1932. It is located on .51 acre in Mansfield, Ohio. The house features a sweeping staircase, baseboards, some wood floors, wainscoting, crown moulding and a galley style kitchen. There is a large den with fireplace and built-in shelving. item.title: All Aboard! Beach access in Washington! C. 1945. $780,000
item.description: All aboard! A Pullman car and two cabooses form this unique residence. Constructed in 1945. It is located on .83 acre in Ocean City, Washington. There are curved ceilings, original racks and a wet bar that once served passengers on the railroad. There is a detached garage, storage shed and an easement to the Pacific Ocean.
